versions.content: Name Can_ Config Type Kind Structure Description This is the type of the external data structure containing the overall initialization data for the CAN driver and SFR settings affecting all controllers. Furthermore it contains pointers to controller configuration structures. The contents of the initializ ation data structure are CAN hardware specific. Available via Can.h
